plan.title: Invite all mapped vendors to an RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the required project title.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Verify that only the RFQ stage is present.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB product with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be completed.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Verify the selected delivery location is retained.
Use the product mapping to add every available mapped vendor.
Verify that the invite-more-participants strip disappears after all mapped vendors are added.
Verify that the RFQ now has invited participants.
Commit the default 30-minute schedule.
Publish the completed RFQ project.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants tab.
Verify that the published stage lists the invited vendors.
